# ClawHub Documentation Context

ClawHub documentation covers CLI usage, authentication, API behavior, skill format rules, package publishing, telemetry, and security audits.

## Useful Documentation

- API docs: https://clawhub.ai/docs/api
- Auth docs: https://clawhub.ai/docs/auth
- Pricing: https://clawhub.ai/pricing.md
- OpenAPI: https://clawhub.ai/api/v1/openapi.json

## Agent Notes

Use documentation pages for current behavior and user-facing commands. Use the OpenAPI description for exact request and response schemas. Skills published on ClawHub use MIT-0 and cannot define paid ClawHub pricing metadata.
